definition: Hunter syndrome is an inherited X-linked disorder in which a lack of the enzyme iduronate sulfatase causes mucopolysaccharides to build up in the body’s organs. It affects males in nearly all cases and can involve mental dysfunction along with physical problems such as an enlarged abdomen, hearing loss, airway disease, heart disease, and enlargement of the liver and spleen.
